notes: #233 phase 2: the gate-passed google/gemma-4-26B-A4B-it-assistant drafter served through the g4moe wgpu engine's new assistant taps; corpus and drafter checkpoint paths are lane-local on this box (wf/g4serve), re-fetch per README in the drafter repo if absent. The 196608 rung is UNMEASURED BY RULE: real-context drafting cannot ride the synthfill depth instrument (garbage KV collapses acceptance), and a real 196k chunked prefill costs ~3.8h/arm (measured 14.3 tok/s prime on the one plain-default deep row in runs.jsonl), which the standing no-multi-hour-primes directive bars without explicit user sanction -- the depth tail stays an open question, not a claim
rationale: The assistant arm cannot run on the flash decode default: Gemma4MoeWgpu::verify_chain refuses flash_decode_enabled() because the m-row pm_attn argmax mismatches the flash decode stream at softcap near-ties, so NV_G4MOE_FLASH_DECODE=0 rides in the assistant arm env as a real serving requirement, not a tuning knob. plain-noflash isolates that decode-graph cost so the assistant read decomposes into (flash-off penalty) + (spec round economics); the arm's own verify/draft/decode medians land in its [G4ASSIST-COST] line per the gate-3 verify-cost statement. plain-default {} and plain-null {NV_G4MOE_ASSISTANT_ARM:0} are a genuine null pair: assistant_arm_on() is an exact string-1 compare, so unset and 0 run the identical plain decode_step loop on the identical graph. Effective tok/s on the assistant arm counts emitted tokens over wall clock across whole spec rounds -- accept-rate collapse shows up as a slow arm, not a hidden one. NV_TIMED_EMITTED_TOKENS=256 bounds round-granularity noise at k=4. Real chat-wrapped corpus prompts per the always-real-templates rule; one engine build serves all three depths per arm.
